PAGE TITLE: MANAGEMENT’S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE
Results of Operations (CONTINUED)
Gross Cost of Operations

CHARTS:
Title: Comparative Gross Cost of Operations By Strategic Goal FY 2024 and FY 2023
Chart Type: Horizontal bar chart
Units: IN MILLIONS
Legend: Orange bar = 2024, Purple bar = 2023
Totals at Top: FY 2024 Total: $26,551 | FY 2023 Total: $26,233

Strategic Goal 1: Expand human knowledge through new scientific discoveries.
FY 2024 Total: $9,128 | FY 2023 Total: $9,166
- Earth Science Research: FY 2024 $578; FY 2023 $522
- Earth Systematic Missions: FY 2024 $831; FY 2023 $748
- Reimbursable-Science Programmatic: FY 2024 $916; FY 2023 $713
- Other Goal 1 Programs: FY 2024 $6,803; FY 2023 $7,183

Strategic Goal 2: Extend human presence to the Moon and on towards Mars for sustainable long-term exploration, development, and utilization.
FY 2024 Total: $11,306 | FY 2023 Total: $11,030
- Human Landing System: FY 2024 $1,144; FY 2023 $1,463
- International Space Station Program: FY 2024 $1,282; FY 2023 $1,313
- Crew and Cargo Program: FY 2024 $1,552; FY 2023 $1,449
- Space Launch System: FY 2024 $2,719; FY 2023 $2,555
- Other Goal 2 Programs: FY 2024 $4,609; FY 2023 $4,250

Strategic Goal 3: Catalyze economic growth and drive innovation to address national challenges.
FY 2024 Total: $3,075 | FY 2023 Total: $3,044
- Technology Demonstration: FY 2024 $369; FY 2023 $337
- Science and Engineering: FY 2024 $577; FY 2023 $655
- Other Goal 3 Programs: FY 2024 $2,129; FY 2023 $2,052

Strategic Goal 4: Enhance capabilities and operations to catalyze current and future mission success.
FY 2024 Total: $3,042 | FY 2023 Total: $2,993
- Infrastructure: FY 2024 $660; FY 2023 $666
- Mission Enabling Service: FY 2024 $683; FY 2023 $686
- Center Engineering, Safety, & Operations: FY 2024 $800; FY 2023 $829
- Other Goal 4 Programs: FY 2024 $899; FY 2023 $812

KEY FACTS:
- Gross cost of operations is presented detailing select NASA programs that support each strategic goal.
- Total Gross Cost of Operations for FY 2024 is $26,551 million, and for FY 2023 is $26,233 million.
- Strategic Goal 1 Total: FY 2024 $9,128 million | FY 2023 $9,166 million.
- Strategic Goal 2 Total: FY 2024 $11,306 million | FY 2023 $11,030 million.
- Strategic Goal 3 Total: FY 2024 $3,075 million | FY 2023 $3,044 million.
- Strategic Goal 4 Total: FY 2024 $3,042 million | FY 2023 $2,993 million.
